e471-emulsifiers.title: E471 · Emulsifiers
e471-emulsifiers.subtitle: BOTIA result: doubt due to missing halal traceability
e471-emulsifiers.botiaNote: The label shows E471. The label does not confirm whether its origin is vegetable, animal, or synthetic. BOTIA flags it because halal traceability is missing. To confirm it, check halal certification or manufacturer documentation. The final decision is yours.
e471-emulsifiers.whyText: E471 can have different origins. If the label does not state the origin or provide halal traceability, BOTIA classifies it as doubtful.
e471-emulsifiers.labelText: The label only shows E471 or emulsifiers. It does not confirm whether it comes from a vegetable, animal, or synthetic source.
checkItems: Confirmation that it does not come from a non-halal animal source.
e471-emulsifiers.limitText: BOTIA does not issue fatwas and does not replace halal certification. It only indicates that the label does not provide enough information to confirm halal origin.
sourcesItems: Official halal certification for the product.
